title: Manual QA Engineer
description:
Manual QA Engineer
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Manual QA Engineer with 5+ years of experience to ensure the quality and reliability of web applications. FinTech experience is a plus but not required.

Responsibilities
-Create and execute test cases and test scenarios.
-Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.
-Test web applications and APIs.
-Identify, document, and track bugs, including clear reproduction steps.
-Verify bug fixes and validate software releases..
-Contribute to test planning, documentation, and QA process improvements.

Requirements
-5+ years of experience in Manual QA / Software Testing.
-Strong understanding of testing methodologies and SDLC.
-Experience with web application and API testing.
-Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
-Familiarity with bug-tracking and test management tools.
-Understanding of REST APIs and client-server architecture.
-Familiarity with Git and modern development workflows.
-Upper-Intermediate English or higher.

Nice to have: FinTech experience, mobile testing, automation basics, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or high-load systems experience.

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and proactive QA Engineer with strong analytical skills and a commitment to delivering reliable software.
